content.text: Key Success Factors
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Key Success Factors

content.text: Let's look at what made this transformation work:
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Let's look at what made this transformation work:

content.text: The trigger was a problem, not a vision.
Hayden's first approach wasn't to use AI—it was finding the right person. The team tried three people before turning to AI.
Claude 3.5 was the breakthrough.
When it launched in June 2024, the writing quality significantly improved.
Train AI on best examples only.
The team gave Claude the top 25-30 emails, not average ones. It learned what actually worked.
Survey the audience.
Those 50-100 responses gave Claude exactly what to write about. AI spots trends faster than humans.
Mix education with sales.
The 3:2 ratio is critical. Pure sales gets unsubscribes. Educational content makes sales emails more effective.
Respect frequency constraints.
Acquira texts every 60-90 days maximum. The list of 15,000 is split into 60 daily segments on a 60-day rotation. You can't just 10x volume without damaging relationships.
Integrate everywhere.

The team added Woo Sender to the paid traffic funnel. When someone becomes a lead but doesn't complete the application, they get an automatic text. This improved lead-to-applicant conversion across all channels.
